prompt: A meeting room table seen from a lens fixed high in the corner of the ceiling, looking down across the room. On the long table stands a large architectural model of an enormous windowless slab of a data centre, flat grey and the size of a coffee table, built on the edge of a little model English town with tiny terraced houses, a church spire and a roundabout. Blue plastic pipes snake from the slab across the green baize landscape towards a model reservoir. Around the table are empty swivel chairs and a flipchart with its pages left blank. The light is flat office strip light, the colour is washed out and compressed, and the picture is grainy with a slight fish-eye curve at the corners. Thanks.
